title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 24
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 24: Jehoiakim's rebellion, Jehoiachin carried away to Babylon and Zedekiah made king.

questions.text: How long was Jehoiakim the servant of Nebuchadnezzar before he rebelled?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 24:1 says Jehoiakim became Nebuchadnezzar's servant three years, then turned and rebelled against him.

questions.text: Which of these groups is named among the bands Yahweh sent against Judah?
questions.explanation: Yahweh sent bands of the Chaldeans, the Syrians, the Moabites and the children of Ammon against Judah to destroy it.

questions.text: For whose sins does the chapter say this came on Judah?
questions.explanation: At the commandment of Yahweh this came on Judah, to remove them out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh and the innocent blood he shed.

questions.text: Who reigned in Jehoiakim's place when he slept with his fathers?
questions.explanation: Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

questions.text: The king of Babylon had taken everything from the brook of Egypt to which river?
questions.explanation: The king of Egypt did not come out of his land any more, for the king of Babylon had taken all from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates.

questions.text: How old was Jehoiachin when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months.

questions.text: What did the king of Babylon cut in pieces?
questions.explanation: He carried out the treasures of Yahweh's house and the king's house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon had made in Yahweh's temple.

answers.text: The gates and walls of Jerusalem
The idols on all the high places
The vessels of gold Solomon had made

questions.text: According to verse 14, who remained in the land?
questions.explanation: He carried away all Jerusalem, the princes, the mighty men and the craftsmen; no one remained except the poorest people of the land.

answers.text: Only the poorest people of the land

questions.text: What new name did the king of Babylon give Mattaniah when he made him king?
questions.explanation: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin's father's brother, king in his place and changed his name to Zedekiah.

questions.text: What does the last verse say Zedekiah did?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 24:20 ends by saying that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

answers.text: He rebelled against the king of Babylon
He surrendered Jerusalem without a fight
